title: Tasteful Boots
html:
Tasteful Boots is a common pair of Camp Shoes.

Made of tough, well-worn leather, these boots have survived years of use, and can survive many more.

Properties

  •  Camp Shoes
  •  Rarity: Common
  •  Weight: 0.55 kg (1.1 lb)
  •  Price: 5 gp
  • UID BASE_Vanity_Shoes_Camp
    UUID 6a491be1-7480-4069-8ac2-277728652fbf
    Stats ARM_Camp_Shoes

Where to find

  • Starting clothing worn by the Custom character or the Dark Urge

Notes

  • Companions start with variants of Tasteful Boots. While called the same, their visuals are different.
